base_contract.rule: Every base-contract clause remains mandatory except where this amendment explicitly replaces it. A scorer must load and hash-check both documents and reject contradictions or missing documents.

scope_preserved.claim: Greedy-argmax, open-fixture, causal proxy accuracy only.
scope_preserved.implementation_authority: This candidate authorizes only contract review. Scorer, packer, replay helper, and trace code remain unauthorized until both reviewers report no critical/high findings.

router_semantics_replacement.projection: For each z_j and target layer l, first run the frozen source operation ds4_gpu_rms_norm_weight_tensor with F32 z_j, the layer's F32 ffn_norm tensor, DS4_N_EMBD=6144, DS4_RMS_EPS, and F32 output. Then run the frozen ds4_gpu_matmul_f32_tensor operation with the layer's F32 ffn_gate_inp tensor, 6144 inputs, 256 outputs, one row, and F32 logits. The reviewed replay helper uses the same frozen CUDA operations; a CPU reimplementation may report diagnostics but cannot grant PASS.
router_semantics_replacement.selection: For expert e, p_e is the CUDA float result of 1.0f/(1.0f+expf(-logit_e)); selection_e is the CUDA float addition p_e + bias_e where bias is the layer's F32 ffn_exp_probs_b value. Per-step ranks sort selection descending, then expert ID ascending on exact float equality, exactly matching glm_router_select_parallel_kernel in ds4_cuda.c SHA-256 1180948d339d8a5b7656e7ec0d2707357d4c94c820ccc1e8844777379ce6b45f.
router_semantics_replacement.cross_step_aggregation: For each expert and K, aggregate max(selection_e) over exactly j=1..K using F32 stored values. Rank the maxima descending then expert ID ascending. Raw logits, p_e alone, normalized routed weights, sums/means, F16/TF32 substitutions, or any other transform are invalid.
tests: F16 and TF32 projection/aggregation mutations fail

candidate_only_tensor_pack.purpose: Remove the full model and every normal target expert byte from the candidate process input surface after source_ready.
candidate_only_tensor_pack.builder: A separately frozen deterministic packer parses the hash-bound GGUF before either phase and copies only the exact allowed tensor names and bytes into a compact O_EXCL pack. It records name, GGUF dtype, dimensions, original absolute offset/length, blob offset/length, and per-blob SHA-256, then fsyncs pack/manifest/directory. No free-form or padding payload is permitted; unused bytes are zero and included in the pack hash.
allowed_tensor_names: every tensor whose exact name begins blk.78.
only blk.L.ffn_norm.weight, blk.L.ffn_gate_inp.weight, and blk.L.ffn_exp_probs_b for each integer L=3..77
candidate_only_tensor_pack.forbidden_inventory: The packer must also publish the exact original [offset,length) inventory for blk.L.ffn_gate_exps.weight, blk.L.ffn_up_exps.weight, and blk.L.ffn_down_exps.weight for every L=3..77. It rejects overlap, aliasing, duplicate names/ranges, overflow, unexpected shapes/types, noncanonical order, or any pack blob not in the finite allowed-name expansion.
candidate_only_tensor_pack.authority: Before candidate execution, an independent validator rereads the model and pack through single O_NOFOLLOW descriptors, recomputes every allowed blob against its original GGUF range, proves that none intersects the forbidden inventory, and freezes the pack/manifest/validator hashes. The full model descriptor is then closed and the validator exits.
candidate_process_policy: The source process runs the normal target only through the prompt, writes raw F32 z_0=h_t plus q1/source identity, fsyncs, and exits before candidate start.

The candidate starts as a fresh process with no inherited descriptor, mapping, CUDA registration, IPC handle, or live source/target process. It is passed only the compact pack, source artifact, output directory, frozen binary/libraries, and required CUDA device handles.

Before parsing untrusted candidate inputs, the launcher applies unprivileged Landlock ABI 7 to allow reads only from the frozen binary/libraries, compact pack, source artifact, CUDA device nodes, and required read-only system runtime paths, and writes only to a fresh output directory. The full GGUF path and its parents are not allowed. Seccomp denies socket creation, ptrace/process_vm access, namespace creation, and opening additional device classes. Environment and inherited FDs are enumerated; any unexpected FD/map fails.
The replay/scorer helper runs in a separate equivalent sandbox over the same pack and raw candidate state. Phase B starts only after both candidate and replay helpers exit and their artifacts freeze.
candidate_only_tensor_pack.enforcement_evidence: Record Landlock ABI/rules, seccomp filter hash, /proc/self/maps, /proc/self/fd targets, pack tensor inventory, forbidden model ranges, model-open EACCES result, and process ancestry. Absence of the full model is an externally checked acceptance condition, not a candidate-owned counter.
mandatory_mutations: attempt to open/read the full GGUF after sandboxing fails with EACCES
add or rename one layer-3 expert blob into the pack and validator fails
direct layer-3 expert lookup has no pack entry and fails independently of dispatch telemetry
relabel a target expert range as blk.78 and validator fails against exact name/shape/range inventory
inherit a full-model descriptor or mapping and preflight fails
unexpected socket, ptrace, process_vm, FD, map, tensor blob, padding payload, or process remains and fails

independent_replay_replacement.raw_candidate_authority: Candidate output must include little-endian contiguous F32 z_0 through z_8 (9 x 6144 values per case), q1 through q9, full F32 head logits for q1 through q9, exact source/min/absolute positions, prompt token-vector hash, MTP selected-slot vector per step, monotonic stage receipts emitted directly at the post-residual boundary, and hashes/sizes for every artifact. Stored router scores/ranks are comparison-only.
independent_replay_replacement.replay: The separately frozen replay helper ignores stored router scores/ranks. Starting only from frozen z_0, q1, t/min_pos, empty private MTP KV, and the compact pack, it reruns all eight glm_graph_mtp_step operations. It independently derives z_1..z_8, head logits/q2..q9, all 75 RMSNorm/router outputs, per-step selection scores/ranks, max-over-j ranks, and both baselines. Candidate and replay z tensors and logits must be bit-identical because they use the same frozen binary/GPU operations; every token, position, slot and integer rank must be exact. Any difference FAILS before target accuracy is scored.
independent_replay_replacement.q1_check: The replay helper recomputes q1 from z_0 with the normal output_norm and shared output head in the compact pack and requires bit-identical logits and argmax to the source artifact.
independent_replay_replacement.scorer_authority: The fixed Python scorer accepts metrics only from replay-derived ranks and Phase-B exact target selections. It hash-checks the base/amendment contracts, pack/manifest, source/candidate/replay/target artifacts, frozen helper binaries and tests, then applies the unchanged v2 n=5 formulas. Candidate-emitted scores/ranks can only cause mismatch failure and never grant a hit.
